failure_cases.must_fail_when: No copy-paste Opus prompt is produced.
The packet lacks exact evidence paths or review questions.
The packet does not define allowed Opus conclusions and next actions.
The packet claims Opus has already reviewed or approved the work.
The packet claims mainline readiness, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
p2-93 no longer proves external review packet readiness.
p2-91/p2-92 proof counts are missing or no longer match expected values.
This slice writes outside its own sandbox path.
